messages:
alex (Finance): Quick sync — Nimbus Health has a billing dispute on their Oct renewal. They say platform fee doubled and support tier proration missing. Can someone pick this up?

marta (AE): Yep saw this in SF. They moved from Enterprise+ -> Enterprise mid-June (ORD-92834). Renewal 2024-10-01. Invoice shows both PLATFORM-FEE-ENTPLUS and PLATFORM-FEE-ENT lines.

jordan (Billing): grabbing INV-554321 now. System emitted two platform_fee SKUs, looks like a dedupe miss during the billing generation.

priya (CS): Customer provided email approval for downgrade dated 2024-06-17, attached to CS-2345. They explicitly requested immediate effect.

ben (Eng Ops): infra note: reserved capacity for nimbus-prod-1 remained at previous sizing until 2024-09-30, autoscale/pin didn't flip earlier. Usage change applied 2024-10-01. So billing saw old capacity for Jul-Sep.

alex (Finance): That explains overlap. Nimbus requests a true-up refund for July-September overlap. Rough ask is ~$18k. We need exact calc + approval path.

jordan (Billing): to compute pro-rate I need ORD-92834 and the effective downgrade date. Also GL code for credit (confirming rev acct).

marta (AE): order id ORD-92834 in SF, SOW link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ORD-92834. Customer signed 2024-06-17.

priya (CS): attaching CS-2345 email thread: "downgrade effective immediately" quote from customer.

jordan (Billing): running pro-rate now. Note: billing engine backfilled platform_fee across the term because capacity flags were still set.

jordan (Billing): calc complete. Overlap charge = $21,450.

marta (AE): can we soften to $18k as customer goodwill?

alex (Finance): I can approve up to $20k one-time credit. Anything above needs director approval. Propose issuing $20,000 credit and log remaining $1,450 as discount hold while ops fixes sync. Update GL 4002 and memo 'onprem true-up goodwill 2024'.

jordan (Billing): will create credit memo referencing INV-554321 and ORD-92834. Creating CM-2024-1002 for $20,000, leaving $1,450 flagged.

ben (Eng Ops): opened infra ticket INF-667 to ensure reserved capacity state changes trigger a billing sync event. ETA to deployment fix: 2024-10-10.

alex (Finance): good. Priya/Marta please confirm message to customer offering $20k credit and ETA on fix.

priya (CS): messaging customer now — offering $20k credit and explaining ops fix scheduled 10/10. Will route for acknowledgement.

marta (AE): will cover on account call tomorrow and confirm retention details.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2024-1002 created for INV-554321 amount $20,000.

alex (Finance): closing once credit posts. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
